command:
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
cd /tmp
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1
sha256sum -c fpcontract.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: fpcontract.py does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
mkdir -p /tmp/out
python3 -u fpcontract.py > /tmp/out/fpcontract.log 2>&1
s=$?
cat /tmp/out/fpcontract.log
test "$s" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: probe exit $s"; exit 1; }
test "$(grep -c '^l2_P2_N64_' /tmp/out/fpcontract.log)" = 2 || { echo "FAIL: not both L2 values"; exit 1; }
echo DONE
